title: Sustainable training load

D0.outcome: Explains a sustainable training load and a re-entry plan after a break.

D1.outcome: Sets a weekly load he kept in the last two weeks.

D2.outcome: Keeps a stated weekly training load for four weeks, or reduces it deliberately and records why.

D3.outcome: After a break of two weeks, follows a re-entry plan that restores the load in stages.

conditions: The load is checked weekly against what was done.
contrasts: A plan of ten hours with a record of three.
Restarting after a break at the old load.
A short holiday of two days.
